sourceId.description:
DB `id` of registered models at the time of registration.
For example, This is {@link MlPipe#id} or {@link MlModel#id} used for registration.

pkgName.description: Name of c3 application package that invoked {@link ModelRegistryIface#register}

pkgVersion.description: {@link Pkg#version} of {@link App} that invoked {@link ModelRegistryIface#register}

description.description: User provided description of this ModelRegistry.Register.Metadata

appMode.description: {@link App#appMode} of {@link App} that invoked {@link ModelRegistryIface#register}

registeredBy.description: Name of user who registered the entry

path.description:
A globally unique path to register a model into model registry.
See {@link ModelRegistry} for definition of a globally unique path.

title: Interface for metadata of {@link ModelRegistryIface#register} operation.
name: ModelRegistry.Register.Metadata
